newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's July copper output rises 16.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Peru's July copper output rises 16.9 pct.

text.p: Peru's copper output rose 16.9 percent to 39,706 tonnes in July compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from the Energy and Mines Ministry released Thursday.
Production rose 22.3 percent to 274,712 tonnes in the first seven months of the year compared with the same period last year, the ministry said.
In 1995, copper output rose 10.8 percent to 404,990 tonnes from 365,513 tonnes in 1994.
Peru is the world's sixth largest copper producer. The country's largest producer, Southern Peru Copper Corp, accounts for around 60 percent of the country's output.
